ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) > DATE(2020, 08, 16), ISBLANK( Secondary_Subscriber_DOB__c ), ISBLANK( Secondary_Subscriber_Name__c ), OR ( ISPICKVAL( Secondary_Subscriber_Relationship__c, 'Spouse'), ISPICKVAL( Secondary_Subscriber_Relationship__c, 'Child'), ISPICKVAL( Secondary_Subscriber_Relationship__c, 'Other') ))
